title: Add bootstrap acquisition driver and retain the HEAD_ABSENT diagnostic
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Add `research/h25-manual-bootstrap-acquisition/`: a fixed pre-entry driver around the published manual parent, 26 new behavioral controls, exact external dependency mapping, Pro/source/result review, and a scoped genuine negative observation.

**One actual normal C2 diagnostic observed the source-fixed financial directory absent (`HEAD_ABSENT`, planned exit 78), under verified real EX with known once-only cleanup, no error and no IO uncertainty. Independent AI review accepted the point-in-time negative. The round closed; optimized native execution, genesis and manual dispatch did not follow.** This is not a financial predecessor, debt/orphan absence proof or positive owner/bootstrap qualification.

Compiler-input closure and the authentic bootstrap-control campaign remain incomplete. The goal service was separately observed paused at this checkpoint.

External dependency [#6709](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6709), exact head `24417a34746985dd110d70a42b2b863b96963c12`, supplies seven existing implementation modules plus thirteen inert donor bodies (893,714 bytes). All twenty have exact public URL/size/SHA256/Git-blob mapping; no duplicate bodies or false ancestry claim. Bounded related-PR research and the complete Pro response are distinguished from global novelty or accepted mathematics.

## Implementation and verification

The one-shot driver retains actual parent startup/loader handles, verifies real C2 EX before any prepare, checks paired canonical nofollow ENOENT, and preflights a bounded complete permitted role graph before actual manual financial meter reading on a present branch. First-error/unknown cleanup remains STOP. It is not a persistent manual IPC bridge. Absolute subject/source bindings need a newly reviewed profile for another installation.

- **26/26 new pure normal and 26/26 new pure optimized:** 52 observations, zero failures/errors/skips; once each, independently accepted against exact source/raw hashes. These literal controls are not the original native campaign.
- **One genuine native normal:** HEAD_ABSENT, two EX observations, known once-only CLOSE_RETURNED, no IO uncertainty or errors; zero financial records, prepare/dispatch disabled. Independently reviewed. **Native optimized 0; reruns 0.**
- Source driver SHA256 `efdeaa05a025de9d457355052a18027c2ce5e1733ae3003d9de2e8782c45dea0`; controls `d3a924a5d8ca48eadfdbf2bfdf3ee709860d43be4103564080c8c60615f1b4eb`. Authored/cold pairs and installed seven source hashes remained unchanged.
- Native CPython 3.12.3 isolated normal mode, GNU TERM20 s/KILL2 s watchdog, 1 GiB AS/20 s CPU/256FD limits; original lock and existing sources preserved. No old meter or unchanged controls rerun.
- GNU wall/CPU/maxRSS: pure normal 0.40 s/0.38 s/24,792 kB; optimized 0.31 s/0.31 s/24,664 kB; native 0.18 s/0.14 s/31,364 kB. Native driver-local interval 127,782,506ns versus Tool wait 0.071924388 s; scopes remain distinct, no speedup/whole-cost claim.
- Passive `python3 -S -s -B check_integrity.py` verifies archive path/byte hashes only; no candidate import/native hook. Raw native EX/FD/process/financial/census and private consultation transport remain local; public summary pins retained raw evidence.

Timing exception preserved: initial 05:29 stop enforced; technical review 05:29:07 was seven seconds late, corrected immutably; parent explicitly reassessed 05:31:14 under standing authorization. No retroactive gate pass, clock reset or hard-limit extension. Source frozen05:38:46 before 05:39; review 05:51/hard05:59 unchanged. Initial control freeze retains an earlier interface snapshot; final source/result review binds final bytes.

New conservative policy debit 100 s (installation 25 + two pure commands 50 + native 25). Supplemental combined 285.890533479 s; canonical historical 94.550533479 s unchanged. Overlapping scopes must not be added. Preparation/Pro/agents/review/cleanup/CI/publication/final metadata and historical gaps remain OPEN_NOT_ZERO.
